versions.localizedDescription:
PROBLEM SOLVED: Take the stress out of managing your health regimen. Forget trying to remember if you took your morning pills or trying to track complex prescription intervals on a paper calendar. Whether you are managing chronic conditions, daily prescriptions, birth control, or a detailed vitamin and supplement routine, Medication List ensures you stay perfectly on track.
With a clean, distraction-free interface, highly customizable scheduling, and glanceable home screen widgets, managing your health has never been easier or more reliable.

KEY FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE:
• HOME SCREEN MEDICATION WIDGETS: Keep your health front and center. Use our sleek iOS Home Screen widgets to view "Today's Meds" at a glance and track your upcoming doses
